title: Contract
intro: The contract is the baseline every request is measured against. Kemudi AI suggests; a project admin decides.
adminOnly: Only project admins can change this.
unavailable: Kemudi AI isn't reachable. Check that the orchestrator and Hermes are running.

upload.title: Contract document
upload.description: Upload the signed SOW or SPK (PDF or DOCX). Kemudi reads it into numbered sections that the baseline cites.
upload.languageHint: AI text for this project is written in this language.
upload.empty: No contract yet. Upload one to start.
upload.noSections: No text was found. A scanned document without a text layer can't be read yet.

rateCard.title: Rate card
rateCard.description: Daily rate per role. Change Request effort is in person-days and priced with this card.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: The scope the contract covers, built from its sections. Edit the draft, then approve it to lock it as a version.
baseline.generating: Reading the contract… this can take a minute.
baseline.approveDesc: It becomes version {{version}}. After that the baseline changes only through an approved Change Request.

backtest.title: Backtest
backtest.description: Replay past requests through the CR check and compare with what the PM decided. Upload a JSON dataset with the requests and the expected label.

metrics.crCaughtDetail: flagged as CR or for clarification
metrics.verdicts: PM review: {{right}} right, {{wrong}} wrong, {{pending}} to review
